name: Clip Sheet
summary: A bottom share sheet whose Copy link sends a link chip arcing into a clipboard that snaps shut
about: A phone-sized guide page with a Share button. The page sinks back as a warm share sheet springs up with the link, five friends, quick apps and a big Copy link button. Copying highlights the address, flies a link chip into the clipboard icon, snaps the clip, fills the button green and scatters little chain links. You can drag the sheet down to close it. It suits blogs, recipe sites, city guides and product pages.
how: Press Share: the page sinks back and the sheet springs up with its rows arriving one by one.
Tap a friend: a ring fills around their face and a tick badge pops when it is sent.
Press Copy link: the address is highlighted and a link chip arcs down into the clipboard icon.
The clip snaps shut, green fills the button, the tick draws and chain links scatter. The link really is on your clipboard.
Message and Email open your apps with the link, Save toggles, and Escape, the close button or a drag down closes the sheet.
